COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
CLCON No.356 of 2026
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Lalit Samant, learned counsel for the 
petitioner.
2. By means of present contempt petition, 
petitioner alleges the willful and deliberate contempt 
of this Court’s order dated 10.10.2018 passed in 
WPSS No.1550 of 2018 and batch of writ petitions, 
wherein, the number of writ petition filed by present 
petitioner was WPSS No.240 of 2018, Arvind Shekhar 
and others v. State of Uttarakhand and others. Those 
writ petitions were disposed of in terms of judgment 
and order dated 11.12.2012 passed by the Division 
Bench of this Court in SPA No.258 of 2012, Balraj 
Singh Negi v. State and another, whereby the appeal 
was allowed and the State Government was directed to 
pay difference of remuneration to the appellant within 
three months from the date of judgment, and to 
continue to pay remuneration to appellant in 
accordance with the directions contained in letter 
dated 30.12.2008, until such time, appellant 
continues to discharge duties as a contract faculty. 
3. Learned counsel for petitioner submits that 
petitioner is also a contractual Instructor with the 
respondent-State in I.T.I. Kanskhet, District Pauri 
Garhwal. It is further contended that the order dated 
11.12.2012 passed by the Division Bench attained 
finality up to Apex Court wherein the Special Leave 
Petitions were dismissed, and review petition also 
came to be rejected on 11.11.2025. Even then, the 
respondent-contemnors are not complying with the  directions contained in letter dated 30.12.2008.
4. Issue notices to respondent-contemnors 
returnable within four weeks.
5. Steps within three days.
6. The respondent-contemnors may file their 
response within three weeks or to comply with the 
order.
7. List this case on 12.08.2026 along with CLCON 
No.342 of 2026.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 17.06.2026 SK
